General knowledge

1
A polar bear is used as the marketing icon for which of these popular products?
A. Hoods Ice Cream
B. Maytag Freezers
C. Klondike Bars
D. Popsicles
Correct answer: C. Klondike Bars

2
Aardvark is a word coming from the Afrikaans/Dutch that literally translates as what?
A. Earth Pig
B. Pig Like
C. Long Nose
D. Ant Eater
Correct answer: A. Earth Pig

3
About how long have ants been around on Earth?
A. 45 milllion years
B. 60 million years
C. 25 million years
D. 8 million years
Correct answer: B. 60 million years

B. Bushes

D. Cats

D. 80 million
Correct answer: A. 66 million
